participation.context: Left the price unspoken, and went ahead of them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Decided on the church hat and one visit, and refused a procession.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Agreed to sit beside her, and stopped a second question.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Stayed with the loom, and left the kitchen able to receive them.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.quote: I am going, Master Shakespeare. Church hat.

relations.note: Alse sits beside her and adds no question
the loom, while the house goes north
relations.quote: I am at the loom, Mistress.

story.body: You let her say she was going. You did not walk her, price her seat, or ask for a verdict in advance. Alse was told to sit and not to add a question. Verbeke kept the loom.

relations.quote: I am going, Master Shakespeare. Church hat.

relations.note: Alse sits beside her and adds no question
the loom, while the house goes north
relations.quote: I am at the loom, Mistress.

title: Heard Mistress Ansell decide to see the play

participation.context: Looked toward the church, and did not enter it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw the moon over the church and stayed at the Theatre's gate until you turned for home.

title: Saw the full moon over Shoreditch church from the gate

participation.context: Wrote the door, the share, and the refusal to total the coffer.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the door was good night and no verdict
the two figures came home unreconciled

story.body: You set down good night and nothing after it. You noted the forty shillings and the box, and you left them unreconciled. You did not count the coffer and you did not price her seat.

title: Wrote that she said only good night
